rules.condition: When constraints are declared for the IP
rules.statement: The two clocks i_clk_wr and i_clk_rd shall be declared as related clocks of one source.

rules.condition: When constraints are declared for the IP
rules.statement: No asynchronous clock group or false path shall be set between i_clk_wr and i_clk_rd.
The read side shall consume a word only when o_empty is 0.
o_empty shall become 0 only after the corresponding word has been written to memory.
The IP shall have no isolation, retention or power sequencing of its own; it sits in one always-on power domain.
On i_rst_n_wr, write pointer shall be 0, o_full 0, o_full_thr 0, o_overflow 0, write FSM RUN, request 0, busy 0.
On i_rst_n_rd, read pointer shall be 0, o_empty 1, o_empty_thr 1, o_underflow 0, read FSM RUN, acknowledge 0.
All flip-flops shall reset asynchronously to 0, except flag registers o_empty and o_empty_thr which reset to 1.
The two hardware resets are asserted together and released synchronously to their own clocks; no operation starts before both are released.

rules.condition: Hardware reset and software reset overlap at any time
rules.statement: A hardware reset shall have priority over a software reset.

rules.condition: When i_rst_n_sw is requested low and the sequence completes
rules.statement: The FIFO shall be empty at the end of the software reset sequence.
